screens.title: Splash & Value Proposition Carousel
screens.implemented: Welcome feature carousel and issuer sign-in
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Native mobile launch animation remains device work

screens.title: Account Registration & Credentials
screens.implemented: Self-service registration at the issuer from "Create account" (OIDC prompt=create): username, email, name, password with a live strength meter (8+ characters, uppercase, symbol), enforced realm password policy and a required synthetic-demo terms checkbox; the new customer returns signed in to start an application
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Email ownership is not verified (OTP provider pending, UI-03); the cloud template keeps registration off; production abuse controls (CAPTCHA, rate limits) pending; a referral code is not collected until referral rewards are approved (UI-14)

screens.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA / OTP)
screens.implemented: Fresh issuer action-bound reauthentication; email ownership by 6-digit one-time code (schema 79): masked destination, six auto-advancing boxes with one-time-code autofill, 45-second resend countdown, 10-minute expiry, 5 attempts, 5 codes per hour; a match marks the issuer email verified
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Delivery is simulated to a local synthetic outbox (simulator.contact_outbox); a real email/SMS provider, the SMS channel and phone numbers are pending provider selection; this is contact verification, not a second sign-in factor

screens.title: KYC Identity Verification
screens.implemented: Persistent synthetic profile/evidence, terms, screening and account opening
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Real address, tax ID, citizenship/employment KYC and provider qualification pending

screens.title: Biometric & Passcode Setup
screens.implemented: Issuer account security and action-bound reauthentication
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Native biometrics, secure device PIN enrollment and physical hardware qualification pending

screens.title: Bank Linking (Plaid / Open Banking)
screens.implemented: Masked synthetic links, disconnect and finite exact approved deposit
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Live bank OAuth and micro-deposit adapters pending

screens.title: Financial Goals & Personalization Quiz
screens.implemented: Persisted multiselect goals and personalization
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Recommendations do not place trades or change account terms

screens.title: Master Home Dashboard (Root Tab 1)
screens.implemented: Native personal net worth, privacy, allocation, activity, quick actions, saving-streak badge, month-start change pill and six-month net-worth history
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Month-start values replay retained journals and position events under current ownership; a holding without a retained price at that instant withholds the change instead of estimating it

screens.title: Savings Hub & Vaults Overview (Root Tab 2)
screens.implemented: Native personal/shared vault balances, progress, invitations, automation links, streak/badge summary and lifetime interest with monthly totals
screens.qualification_or_remaining: An APY badge requires an activated approved offer; vault balances are not interest-bearing

screens.title: Create / Edit Savings Vault
screens.implemented: Create/edit exact named target, date and icon; suggested weekly and 30-day contributions; one bounded PNG/JPEG goal photo per vault, visible to members (schema 77)
screens.qualification_or_remaining: A goal photo is presentation metadata only; it never changes a balance

screens.title: Vault Detail & Ledger
screens.implemented: Native vault ledger, deposits, withdrawals and lock
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Recent ledger is bounded to 100 facts; full balance remains native

screens.title: Spare-Change Round-Ups Configuration
screens.implemented: Approved round-ups, multiplier, linked card/vault, weekly cap, trailing-30-day and lifetime native saved totals
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Round-ups apply only to synthetic card purchases; real card network adapters pending

screens.title: Recurring Auto-Save Rules
screens.implemented: Approved calendar-based recurring savings with durable unique runs, pause/resume/cancel and issuer-approved edits; merchant- or category-triggered fixed saving rules approved by the issuer, applied once per card purchase within a weekly cap (schema 76) and counted toward saving streaks, badges and lifetime totals (schema 78)
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Rule savings are excluded from spending; a failed rule saving never reverses the purchase

screens.title: High-Yield APY & Interest Tracker
screens.implemented: Existing exact approved account periodic disclosures, interest receipts and consent; lifetime interest net of corrections and monthly interest totals
screens.qualification_or_remaining: APY boost/referral challenges pending approved product rules

screens.title: Shared / Group Savings Vault
screens.implemented: Invitations, contributions, mutual approval, holds, native shared payouts and per-member lifetime contribution breakdown
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Other members are labelled by ordinal, not identity; shared pools stay excluded from personal net worth

screens.title: Savings Milestones & Gamification Badges
screens.implemented: 26-week saving heatmap, current/longest daily and monthly streaks, eight-badge catalogue with progress and first unlock date, and a balance-free milestone card
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Card is rendered in the browser with no balances; the share sheet appears only where the browser supports file sharing, otherwise the image is saved

screens.title: Spend & Budgeting Overview (Root Tab 3)
screens.implemented: Full-month native income/spending, category budgets, rollover and a labelled safe-to-spend figure: available balance minus approved automations and bill reminders due by month end (schema 76)
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Safe-to-spend is a stated local rule, not a cash-flow forecast or advice; an approved forecasting model remains a product decision

screens.title: Spending Analytics & Cash Flow Breakdown
screens.implemented: Native full-period category allocation, merchant totals and averages
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Cross-period interactive drilldown charts remain enhancement work

screens.title: Category Budget Editor
screens.implemented: Persisted category limit, rollover and threshold with native threshold notifications
screens.qualification_or_remaining: A budget does not constrain financial posting

screens.title: Transaction Detail & Receipt Split
screens.implemented: Exact native transaction, category/note, bounded receipt, equal multi-party split of an outgoing transaction (exact remainder, one request per participant) and paid-request linking to a settled exact internal payment (schema 76)
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Requests are not transfers; each payment still needs its own quote and issuer approval

screens.title: Recurring Bills & Subscription Manager
screens.implemented: Stored bill reminders and explicit cancellation-request state
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Merchant cancellation/payment confirmation requires an adapter

screens.title: Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Send & Request Money
screens.implemented: Native internal/simulated payment quotes, exact approval, requests, split requests and favourite receiving references (schema 76); QR payment codes for a receiving reference and for open requests, and decoded code text fills in a recipient
screens.qualification_or_remaining: In-app camera scanning needs a device camera; a code only fills in a recipient and every payment still needs its own quote and approval

screens.title: PiggyBank Debit & Virtual Cards Hub
screens.implemented: Synthetic virtual card, freeze, online/ATM preference and approved token reveal/purchase
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Real PAN/CVV, networks, ATM and device enrollment require adapters

screens.title: Add Money / Deposit & Withdrawal Hub
screens.implemented: Finite approved synthetic funding and native broker/bank transfers
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Real linked-bank inbound/outbound verification and settlement remain provider work

screens.title: Profile, Security & Account Settings (Root Tab 5)
screens.implemented: Contact servicing, security link, goals, appearance, scopes and exports
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Native device notification permissions are not supplied by the browser preference

screens.title: Notification Center & Smart Alerts
screens.implemented: Native notifications, category/unread filters, mark read, safe links and existing support
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Native device push delivery is not qualified

screens.title: Investments Hub & Portfolio Dashboard (Root Tab 4)
screens.implemented: Native funded portfolio, buying power, allocation, holdings, actual observations and asset search
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Live market movers, market calendar and latency targets are not supplied

screens.title: Asset Detail & Market Research
screens.implemented: Synthetic assets, retained fixture observations, position details, watchlist/alerts and DRIP
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Live fundamentals, research, analyst/news feeds and external market history pending

screens.title: Order Execution Ticket (Buy / Sell)
screens.implemented: Exact fractional amount/shares, buy/sell, market/limit, TIF, presets/max and native validation
screens.qualification_or_remaining: PDT/good-faith/margin eligibility are not qualified for real markets

screens.title: Order Review & Confirmation Receipt
screens.implemented: Full immutable review, actual issuer approval, execution status and native fill receipt
screens.qualification_or_remaining: OPEN is distinct from FILLED; no cosmetic device approval bypass

screens.title: Portfolio Analytics & Asset Allocation
screens.implemented: Native position allocation by asset class, sector or holding, realized/unrealized return, highest/lowest performers, recorded cash/equity, dividend receipts and indicative income outlook
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Market benchmark comparison requires a supplied benchmark feed; recorded values include contributions and are not a return series

screens.title: Recurring Investments (Auto-Invest) Management
screens.implemented: Approved recurring buys, exact cadence/monthly anchor, due-date uniqueness, pause/resume/cancel, issuer-approved edits, version history and native monthly-commitment/invested summaries
screens.qualification_or_remaining: Edits create a new approved version; the monthly commitment is a cadence projection, not a forecast of fills
